Weakest calls: Vivaldi chamber concertos RV 88-107 (own-line for the bassoon by title, part-books and Lasocki's 'bass, soloist or both'; only RV 104 is documented as a solo role; RV 97 folded); Schmelzer Duben sonatas Lanterly and Pastorale (own-line by analogy with the Duodena gamba); Telemann TWV 44:33 (own-line by analogy with 44:32); Stradella D minor, Wassenaer, Williams, Young 1653, Uccellini (folded for lack of evidence).
